row: As Romatem Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Health Group, we provide physical therapy and rehabilitation services with advanced technologies and an expert team. With a wide range of treatments, from robotic systems to manual therapy, we help our patients achieve a healthy life. As Turkey's first and only chain physical therapy brand, we offer services at international standards and play an important role in the field of medical tourism. By providing quality treatment to our patients from abroad, we are progressing towards becoming a globally recognized brand.
